month_summary: August 1914 marked the opening month of World War I with rapid German advances on multiple fronts. Major events included the fall of Liège, German victories at the Battle of the Frontiers forcing British and French retreats, the beginning of the Great Retreat, and the opening of colonial campaigns in Africa and Asia with the Kamerun campaign and Siege of Tsingtao. Political truces established in France and Germany. Serbian forces achieved early success against Austria-Hungary at Battle of Cer.
